LESSON: FUNCTIONS OF THE BIBLE

Grade: Grade 7
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: The Bible
Topic 3.1: Functions of the Bible

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Functions of the Bible. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: Why is the Bible important in the life of a Christian?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. explain the importance of the Bible in the society today
2. describe how the Bible promotes holistic growth
3. appreciate the Bible as the inspired Word of God

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE STUDYING: FUNCTIONS OF THE BIBLE
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION · Grade: Grade 7
This is a learner study lesson (not a teacher guide). Read every part, follow the models, then practise.

BIG PICTURE
Functions of the Bible helps you succeed in CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION. You will understand it, practise it, and use it at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

KEY FACTS: FUNCTIONS OF THE BIBLE
Study Functions of the Bible like a learner textbook page: meaning → examples → practice → check.
Replace teacher words with your own words.
If a step is unclear, rewrite it shorter and try again.

PART 1: Explain the importance of the Bible in the society today

What this means
In this part you learn to explain the importance of the Bible in the society today. You will use ideas from at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: explain the importance of the Bible in the society today.
2. Reflect, retell, then practise a good habit using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Value in action: Show how “Functions of the Bible” looks when you treat a classmate kindly.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can explain the importance of the Bible in the society today. Write or say your answer clearly.

PART 2: Describe how the Bible promotes holistic growth

What this means
In this part you learn to describe how the Bible promotes holistic growth. You will use ideas from at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: describe how the Bible promotes holistic growth.
2. Reflect, retell, then practise a good habit using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Story link: Retell a short faith/values story connected to Functions of the Bible in your own words.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can describe how the Bible promotes holistic growth. Write or say your answer clearly.

PART 3: Appreciate the Bible as the inspired Word of God

What this means
In this part you learn to appreciate the Bible as the inspired Word of God. You will use ideas from at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: appreciate the Bible as the inspired Word of God.
2. Reflect, retell, then practise a good habit using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Daily habit: Choose one good action to practise today because of this lesson.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can appreciate the Bible as the inspired Word of God. Write or say your answer clearly.

PUT IT TOGETHER
Close your notes and say aloud: what Functions of the Bible is, one example, and one way you will practise this week.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Show how “Functions of the Bible” looks when you treat a classmate kindly. (skill: explain the importance of the Bible in the society today)

Example 2: Retell a short faith/values story connected to Functions of the Bible in your own words. (skill: describe how the Bible promotes holistic growth)

Example 3: Choose one good action to practise today because of this lesson. (skill: appreciate the Bible as the inspired Word of God)

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Write 5 sentences (or show 5 clear steps) that teach Functions of the Bible to a classmate.
2. Practise this skill: explain the importance of the Bible in the society today.
3. Practise this skill: describe how the Bible promotes holistic growth.
4. Practise this skill: appreciate the Bible as the inspired Word of God.
5. Make one local Kenya example of Functions of the Bible from your county, market, farm, or school.
6. Mark your own work: What did you get right? What will you redo?

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. In your exercise book, make a one-page revision sheet for Functions of the Bible: meaning, 3 examples, 5 practice items.
2. Teach a parent/guardian or younger sibling one part of this lesson (2 minutes).
3. Answer in writing: Why should a Grade 7 learner study Functions of the Bible?
4. Prepare for the quiz: cover the Remember box and recite it.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. Why is the Bible important in the life of a Christian?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Know what Functions of the Bible means in your own words.
2. Use local Kenyan examples, not only definitions.
3. Practise in small steps, then check your work.
4. Be able to: explain the importance of the Bible in the society today.
5. Be able to: describe how the Bible promotes holistic growth.

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original study notes from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
